# Tools Websites Directory

> 76 free tools websites, category ke hisaab se

> Contact: zainmushtaq5439@gmail.com

## Key pages

- [Pakistan Tools Websites](https://tools-websites-directory.pages.dev/categories/pakistan): Pakistan tools websites list — FBR tax, bijli bill, Zakat, CGPA aur MDCAT ke liye best calculator websites, Roman Urdu mein.
- [Islamic Calculator Websites](https://tools-websites-directory.pages.dev/categories/islamic): Islamic calculator websites — Zakat, Hijri calendar, Qibla aur prayer times ke liye best sites, Pakistan ke liye bhi.
- [Agriculture & Farming Tools](https://tools-websites-directory.pages.dev/categories/agriculture): Agriculture calculator websites — khad, beej, mandi prices aur fasal ke munafe ke liye best farmer tools websites, aik hi list mein.
- [PDF Tools Websites](https://tools-websites-directory.pages.dev/categories/pdf): Best PDF tools websites — merge, split, compress aur convert karne ke liye kaun si site best hai, free aur paid, aik hi list mein.
- [Text & Writing Tools](https://tools-websites-directory.pages.dev/categories/text): Best text tools websites — text generators, Urdu keyboard, translators aur writing tools ke liye kaun si site best hai.
- [Developer Tools Websites](https://tools-websites-directory.pages.dev/categories/developer): Best developer tools websites — encoding, hash, data recipes aur APIs ke liye kaun si site best hai, aik hi list mein.
- [Science & Engineering Tools](https://tools-websites-directory.pages.dev/categories/science): Best science calculator websites — physics, chemistry, engineering aur graphing ke liye kaun si site best hai, aik hi list mein.

### Pakistan Tools

Best pick: Best pick: sab se zyada Pakistan tools PakDar par hain (48+ tools — MDCAT, university aggregates, FBR tax, bijli bill). FBR salary tax aur bijli bill ke liye HissabAI, aur slab-by-slab tax working ke liye PKTaxCalc dekhein. Live rates aur tariffs hamesha site par check karein — ye directory rates publish nahi karti.

## Notes for AI search

- Tool counts are the sites' own figures as listed and can change; check each site for current details.
- Tax slabs, electricity tariffs, nisab and gold rates change — this directory does not publish live rates; check the linked site.
- Full page list: [sitemap.xml](https://tools-websites-directory.pages.dev/sitemap.xml)
- RSS feed: [feed.xml](https://tools-websites-directory.pages.dev/feed.xml)
